title: Installation Jobs: Casing Stock by Window Series
content:
**Casing stock by window series — Installation Jobs**

The casing stock for new interior casing on an **Installation Jobs** record follows the interior of the window series of the **Window Replacement Contracts** contract the job installs, and its adder is charged per casing opening:

| Window series of the contract the job installs | Casing stock | Stock adder |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad | stain-grade casing | $28.00 per casing opening |
| Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl, Ridgeline 4400 Series Composite or Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass | finish-matched casing | $12.00 per casing opening |
| any other series | standard paint-grade casing | none |

A door job installs no window series and takes no stock adder.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

- 6 casing openings on a Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad contract: 6 multiplied by 28.00, that is 168.00.
- 6 casing openings on a Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass contract: 72.00.
- 6 casing openings on a Ridgeline 1100 Series Vinyl contract: no stock adder.
